symbol-search.desc: Search for best-matching symbols based on your query. You can input anything from symbol, security's name to ISIN and Cusip.

stock-symbols.desc: List supported stocks. We use the following symbology to identify stocks on Finnhub Exchange_Ticker.Exchange_Code . A list of supported exchange codes can be found here .

market-status.desc: Get current market status for global exchanges (whether exchanges are open or close).

market-holiday.desc: Get a list of holidays for global exchanges.

company-profile.desc: Get general information of a company. You can query by symbol, ISIN or CUSIP

company-profile2.desc: Get general information of a company. You can query by symbol, ISIN or CUSIP. This is the free version of Company Profile .

company-executive.desc: Get a list of company's executives and members of the Board.

company-news.desc: List latest company news by symbol. This endpoint is only available for North American companies.

press-releases.desc: Get latest major press releases of a company. This data can be used to highlight the most significant events comprised of mostly press releases sourced from the exchanges, BusinessWire, AccessWire, GlobeNewswire, Newsfile, and PRNewswire. Full-text press releases data is available for Enterprise clients. Contact Us to learn more.

news-sentiment.desc: Get company's news sentiment and statistics. This endpoint is only available for US companies.

company-peers.desc: Get company peers. Return a list of peers operating in the same country and sector/industry.

company-basic-financials.desc: Get company basic financials such as margin, P/E ratio, 52-week high/low etc.

price-metrics.desc: Get company price performance statistics such as 52-week high/low, YTD return and much more.

symbol-change.desc: Get a list of symbol changes for US-listed, EU-listed, NSE and ASX securities. Limit to 2000 events at a time.

isin-change.desc: Get a list of ISIN changes for EU-listed securities. Limit to 2000 events at a time.

historical-market-cap.desc: Get historical market cap data for global companies.

historical-employee-count.desc: Get historical employee count for global companies.

institutional-profile.desc: Get a list of well-known institutional investors. Currently support 60+ profiles.

institutional-portfolio.desc: Get the holdings/portfolio data of institutional investors from 13-F filings. Limit to 1 year of data at a time. You can get a list of supported CIK here .

institutional-ownership.desc: Get a list institutional investors' positions for a particular stock overtime. Data from 13-F filings. Limit to 1 year of data at a time.

ownership.desc: Get a full list of shareholders of a company in descending order of the number of shares held. Data is sourced from 13F form , Schedule 13D and 13G for US market, UK Share Register for UK market, SEDI for Canadian market and equivalent filings for other international markets.

fund-ownership.desc: Get a full list fund and institutional investors of a company in descending order of the number of shares held. Data is sourced from 13F form , Schedule 13D and 13G for US market, UK Share Register for UK market, SEDI for Canadian market and equivalent filings for other international markets.

insider-transactions.desc: Company insider transactions data sourced from Form 3,4,5 , SEDI and relevant companies' filings. This endpoint covers US, UK, Canada, Australia, India, and all major EU markets. Limit to 100 transactions per API call.

insider-sentiment.desc: Get insider sentiment data for US companies calculated using method discussed here . The MSPR ranges from -100 for the most negative to 100 for the most positive which can signal price changes in the coming 30-90 days.

financials.desc: Get standardized balance sheet, income statement and cash flow for global companies going back 30+ years. Data is sourced from original filings most of which made available through SEC Filings and International Filings endpoints. Set preliminary param to true for faster updates for US companies. Wondering why our standardized data is different from Bloomberg, Reuters, Factset, S&P or Yahoo Finance ? Check out our FAQ page to learn more

financials-reported.desc: Get financials as reported. This data is available for bulk download on Kaggle SEC Financials database .

revenue-breakdown.desc: Get revenue breakdown as-reporetd by product and geography. Users on personal plans can access data for US companies which disclose their revenue breakdown in the annual or quarterly reports. Global standardized revenue breakdown/segments data is available for Enterprise users. Contact us to inquire about the access for Global standardized data.

filings.desc: List company's filing. Limit to 250 documents at a time. This data is available for bulk download on Kaggle SEC Filings database .

filings-sentiment.desc: Get sentiment analysis of 10-K and 10-Q filings from SEC. An abnormal increase in the number of positive/negative words in filings can signal a significant change in the company's stock price in the upcoming 4 quarters. We make use of Loughran and McDonald Sentiment Word Lists to calculate the sentiment for each filing.

similarity-index.desc: Calculate the textual difference between a company's 10-K / 10-Q reports and the same type of report in the previous year using Cosine Similarity. For example, this endpoint compares 2019's 10-K with 2018's 10-K. Companies breaking from its routines in disclosure of financial condition and risk analysis section can signal a significant change in the company's stock price in the upcoming 4 quarters.

sector-metric.desc: Get ratios for different sectors and regions/indices.

stock-dividends.desc: Get dividends data for common stocks going back 30 years.

recommendation-trends.desc: Get latest analyst recommendation trends for a company.

upgrade-downgrade.desc: Get latest stock upgrade and downgrade.

company-dps-estimates.desc: Get company's Dividend per Share estimates.

company-fcf-estimates.desc: Get company's free cash flow estimates.

company-ocf-estimates.desc: Get company's operating cash flow estimates.

company-earnings.desc: Get company historical quarterly earnings surprise going back to 2000.

earnings-calendar.desc: Get historical and coming earnings release. EPS and Revenue in this endpoint are non-GAAP, which means they are adjusted to exclude some one-time or unusual items. This is the same data investors usually react to and talked about on the media. Estimates are sourced from both sell-side and buy-side analysts.

quote.desc: Get real-time quote data for US stocks. Constant polling is not recommended. Use websocket if you need real-time updates. Real-time stock prices for international markets are supported for Enterprise clients via our partner's feed. Contact Us to learn more.

stock-candles.desc: Get candlestick data (OHLCV) for stocks. Daily data will be adjusted for Splits. Intraday data will remain unadjusted. Only 1 month of intraday will be returned at a time. If you need more historical intraday data, please use the from and to params iteratively to request more data.

stock-nbbo.desc: Get historical best bid and offer for US stocks, LSE, TSX, Euronext and Deutsche Borse. For US market, this endpoint only serves historical NBBO from the beginning of 2026. To download more historical data, please visit our bulk download page in the Dashboard here .

stock-bidask.desc: Get last bid/ask data for US stocks.

indices-constituents.desc: Get a list of index's constituents. A list of supported indices for this endpoint can be found here .

etfs-profile.desc: Get ETF profile information. This endpoint has global coverage. A list of supported ETFs can be found here .

etfs-holdings.desc: Get full ETF holdings/constituents. This endpoint has global coverage. Widget only shows top 10 holdings. A list of supported ETFs can be found here .

etfs-allocation.desc: Get ETF equity allocation based on the characteristics of the holdings.

mutual-fund-profile.desc: Get mutual funds profile information. This endpoint covers both US and global mutual funds. For international funds, you must query the data using ISIN. A list of supported funds can be found here .

mutual-fund-holdings.desc: Get full Mutual Funds holdings/constituents. This endpoint covers both US and global mutual funds. For international funds, you must query the data using ISIN. A list of supported funds can be found here .

mutual-fund-sector-exposure.desc: Get Mutual Funds sector exposure data.

mutual-fund-country-exposure.desc: Get Mutual Funds country exposure data.

mutual-fund-eet.desc: Get EET data for EU funds. For PAIs data, please see the EET PAI endpoint.

mutual-fund-eet-pai.desc: Get EET PAI data for EU funds.

forex-candles.desc: Get candlestick data for forex symbols.

forex-rates.desc: Get rates for all forex pairs. Ideal for currency conversion

crypto-symbols.desc: List supported crypto symbols by exchange

crypto-candles.desc: Get candlestick data for crypto symbols.

pattern-recognition.desc: Run pattern recognition algorithm on a symbol. Support double top/bottom, triple top/bottom, head and shoulders, triangle, wedge, channel, flag, and candlestick patterns.

support-resistance.desc: Get support and resistance levels for a symbol.

aggregate-indicator.desc: Get aggregate signal of multiple technical indicators such as MACD, RSI, Moving Average v.v. A full list of indicators can be found here .

technical-indicator.desc: Return technical indicator with price data. List of supported indicators can be found here .

transcripts-list.desc: List earnings call transcripts' metadata. This endpoint is available for Global companies. You can get a list of supported symbols here

transcripts.desc: Get earnings call transcripts, audio and participants' list. Data is available for US, UK, European, Australian and Canadian companies. 15+ years of data is available with 220,000+ audio which add up to 7TB in size.

earnings-call-live.desc: Stream live earnings calls with data provided in the calendar. The data will be available in m3u8 format. mp3 files will be available once the calls finish in the recording field.

stock-presentation.desc: Get presentations/slides data in PDF format that are usually used during earnings calls. You can get a list of supported symbols here

social-sentiment.desc: Get social sentiment for stocks on Reddit and Twitter.

investment-themes.desc: Thematic investing involves creating a portfolio (or portion of a portfolio) by gathering together a collection of companies involved in certain areas that you predict will generate above-market returns over the long term. Themes can be based on a concept such as ageing populations or a sub-sector such as robotics, and drones. Thematic investing focuses on predicted long-term trends rather than specific companies or sectors, enabling investors to access structural, one-off shifts that can change an entire industry. This endpoint will help you get portfolios of different investment themes that are changing our life and are the way of the future. A full list of themes supported can be found he

supply-chain-relationships.desc: This endpoint provides an overall map of public companies' key customers and suppliers. The data offers a deeper look into a company's supply chain and how products are created. The data will help investors manage risk, limit exposure or generate alpha-generating ideas and trading insights.

company-esg-score.desc: This endpoint provides the latest ESG scores and important indicators for 7000+ global companies. The data is collected through company's public ESG disclosure and public sources. Our ESG scoring models takes into account more than 150 different inputs to calculate the level of ESG risks and how well a company is managing them. A higher score means lower ESG risk or better ESG management. ESG scores are in the the range of 0-100. Some key indicators might contain letter-grade score from C- to A+ with C- is the lowest score and A+ is the highest score.

company-historical-esg-score.desc: This endpoint provides historical ESG scores and important indicators for 7000+ global companies. The data is collected through company's public ESG disclosure and public sources. Our ESG scoring models takes into account more than 150 different inputs to calculate the level of ESG risks and how well a company is managing them. A higher score means lower ESG risk or better ESG management. ESG scores are in the the range of 0-100. Some key indicators might contain letter-grade score from C- to A+ with C- is the lowest score and A+ is the highest score.

company-earnings-quality-score.desc: This endpoint provides Earnings Quality Score for global companies. Earnings quality refers to the extent to which current earnings predict future earnings. "High-quality" earnings are expected to persist, while "low-quality" earnings do not. A higher score means a higher earnings quality Finnhub uses a proprietary model which takes into consideration 4 criteria: Profitability Growth Cash Generation & Capital Allocation Leverage We then compare the metrics of each company in each category against its peers in the same industry to gauge how quality its earnings is.

covid-19.desc: Get real-time updates on the number of COVID-19 (Corona virus) cases in the US with a state-by-state breakdown. Data is sourced from CDC and reputable sources. You can also access this API here

fda-committee-meeting-calendar.desc: FDA's advisory committees are established to provide functions which support the agency's mission of protecting and promoting the public health, while meeting the requirements set forth in the Federal Advisory Committee Act. Committees are either mandated by statute or established at the discretion of the Department of Health and Human Services. Each committee is subject to renewal at two-year intervals unless the committee charter states otherwise.

stock-uspto-patent.desc: List USPTO patents for companies. Limit to 250 records per API call.

stock-visa-application.desc: Get a list of H1-B and Permanent visa applications for companies from the DOL. The data is updated quarterly.

stock-lobbying.desc: Get a list of reported lobbying activities in the Senate and the House.

stock-usa-spending.desc: Get a list of government's spending activities from USASpending dataset for public companies. This dataset can help you identify companies that win big government contracts which is extremely important for industries such as Defense, Aerospace, and Education. Only recent data is available via the API. For historical data, you can download it here: Pre-2021 , 2021 , 2022 , 2023 , 2024

congressional-trading.desc: Get stock trades data disclosed by members of congress.

bond-profile.desc: Get general information of a bond. You can query by FIGI, ISIN or CUSIP. A list of supported bonds can be found here .

bank-branch.desc: Retrieve list of US bank branches information for a given symbol.

airline-price-index.desc: The Flight Ticket Price Index API provides comprehensive data on airline ticket prices, including the average daily ticket price and its percentage change (price index). This data, collected weekly and projected two weeks ahead, aggregates daily prices and indexes from the 50 busiest and largest airports across the USA. The dataset includes detailed information on airlines, dates, and average ticket prices, offering valuable insights for market analysis and pricing strategies. The price index is calculated as percentage change of average daily ticket price from the previous weekly reading. Raw ticket prices data is available for Enterprise users. Contact us to inquire about the raw price dat

economic-calendar.desc: Get recent and upcoming economic releases. Historical events and surprises are available for Enterprise clients.

economic-code.desc: List codes of supported economic data.

international-filings.desc: List filings for international companies. Limit to 500 documents at a time. These are the documents we use to source our fundamental data. Enterprise clients who need access to the full filings for global markets should contact us for the access.

revenue-breakdown2.desc: Get standardized revenue breakdown and KPIs data for 30,000+ global companies.

newsroom.desc: Get latest articles posted directly on the companies' newsroom and investor relations page. Newsroom API along with the Press Releases API provide a comprehensive text-based dataset directly from the company. We currently cover 1,250 US Companies with this dataset.

ai-chat.desc: Chat with our AI copilot trained on the extensive Finnhub's global data. You can ask it any finance-related questions just like with other LLM models and receive results in texts and widgets.

global-filings-search.desc: Search for best-matched filings across global companies' filings, transcripts and press releases. You can filter by anything from symbol, ISIN to form type, and document sources. This endpoint will return a list of documents that match your search criteria. If you would like to get the excerpts as well, please set highlighted to true . Once you have the list of documents, you can get a list of excerpts and positions to highlight the document using the /search-in-filing endpoint

search-in-filing.desc: Get a list of excerpts and highlight positions within a document using your query.

global-filings-search-filter.desc: Get available values for each filter in search body.
